description: Couverture 2G, 3G, 4G à Soissons par opérateur Juillet 2015 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Soissons. Ce jeu de données présente les taux de couverture mobile 2G, 3G et 4G en France métropolitaine par opérateur, établis en juillet 2015 par l’ARCEP. Ces taux ont été calculés à partir des cartes de couverture fournies par les opérateurs, et tiennent compte des accords de mutualisation et d’itinérance. Coverage: Ville de Soissons. The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Soissons. Its keywords include population, telecommunication, couverture-4g, surfacique, bouygues, sfr. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2025-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
